subject: prd/e2e-verification
statement: The coverage map shall map each required behavior of the feature to the scenario(s) that prove it, with no required behavior left unmapped.
rationale: coverage is an explicit checkable list, not left to agent judgment — the reviewers' yardstick
fit_criterion: on the fixtures, every required behavior enumerated from the feature's PRD/design appears in the coverage map with ≥1 scenario or an explicit routed disposition; a seeded uncovered behavior is detectable as an unmapped entry
